title: The tollman's sleep flag (sleep.json)
description: Present while the tollman sleeps (hal2 plan 0365 D3): its round starts no train and no land run; written and removed only by hal2-roles (`hal2-cli-roles sleep tollman on|off`).

by.description: Who put the tollman to sleep (`user`, a session).

at.description: When, RFC 3339 UTC with `Z` and whole seconds.

why.description: The reason given; empty when none was.
